ROMAN TIMES CHESS · A ROMAN-INSPIRED SET WITH CLASSIC CHESS RULES

Command your army

Play classic chess against the computer. White moves first. Tap one of your pieces, then a highlighted destination. Your king may never be left in check.

King / EmperorOne square in any direction.
Queen / EmpressAny distance along ranks, files or diagonals.
Bishop / PriestAny distance diagonally.
Knight / CavalryAn L shape: two squares, then one. Jumps over pieces.
Rook / WatchtowerAny distance straight across or up and down.
Pawn / LegionnaireForward one; two from its starting square. Captures one square diagonally.
  • Checkmate: Win when the opposing king is in check and has no legal escape.
  • Castling: Move your king two squares toward a rook when legal. Neither may have moved, the path must be clear, and the king cannot castle out of, through, or into check.
  • En passant: A pawn may capture a neighbouring pawn just after it advances two squares, when the special capture is legal.
  • Promotion: A pawn reaching the last rank can become a queen, rook, bishop or knight. Choose the figure you want.
  • Draws: Stalemate and insufficient material are detected. For relaxed play, this game automatically accepts a draw at threefold repetition or 50 moves by each side without a pawn move or capture.
  • Exit: Save & Exit pauses the match. Resume Game restores it in this browser on this device. Saves do not transfer between devices, browsers, files or web addresses.

Music is an original, quiet lyre-and-flute-inspired accompaniment. Tap Music on to start it; browsers require that tap. Computer levels are casual game difficulties, not rated playing strengths.
